skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Tianshi garb worn by Leizi upon becoming just a Tianshi again.
Thanks to the technological prowess of the Tianshi Bureaus, its materials and make are both of the highest quality, allowing the wearer to cast powerful Arts with graceful elegance.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The gown of the Judicial Review Office is cast off, and the robe of a Tianshi is donned.
A change of clothes only signifies a change in office. Leizi's will is the same as ever.

skins.name: The Bloodwing Rose
skins.content: Achievement Star Collection/The Bloodwing Rose. Leizi's character in 'Dark Age of Terra'. Amidst bloodwing's roar, twisting, thorned peals of thunder descend. Of all the challenges the adventurers have faced, she is the prickliest by far.
skins.usage: One of Leizi the Thunderbringer's role-playing outfits.
skins.quote: If you wish to uncover the secrets of the ancients, if you wish to obtain power sealed away, you must be of tremendous courage and inordinate resilience. In this inescapable, ultimate trial, she shall be your opponent.
